title: GC policy uses only first Newsgroups entry for cross-posted articles
description: transit/src/peering/pipeline.rs:237: primary_group = group_name_strs.first(). The articles table INSERT stores only the first group from the Newsgroups header. When GC evaluates whether to keep an article, ArticleMeta.group contains only that first group. If an operator configures group-specific retention (e.g., pin comp.* forever, expire alt.* after 7 days) and an article is cross-posted as 'Newsgroups: alt.binaries.test,comp.lang.rust', the GC evaluates it as an alt.* article and may expire it even though it is also in comp.lang.rust. The outcome depends on header ordering, not the article's actual group membership. Fix: either insert one articles table row per group (changing PRIMARY KEY to cid+group_name), or evaluate GC policy against all groups in the Newsgroups header.
